records.title: Preserve test data inheritance and exact shared-step Defect evidence · SYNTHETIC SAMPLE
records.description:
As a QA engineer, I want reusable test data to keep its declared scope and saved execution evidence so that I can review a failure without losing the original inputs.

SYNTHETIC SAMPLE: these authored examples illustrate dataset inheritance, review queues and Defect traceability. No browser, integration, CI job or production service was executed.
records.specification_content:
Feature: Saved test data inheritance
  Scenario: Keep one shared default row
    Given a shared group with one linked data row
    When a case has not enabled shared-data override
    Then the group retains its own input
  Scenario: Record a run-level override
    Given an explicit run-level override
    When the two synthetic input rows are reviewed
    Then each result retains its exact input row and shared-step Defect link
gherkin_scenarios: Given one shared data row When the case disables shared-data override Then the shared default is preserved
Given explicit run overrides When synthetic result rows are reviewed Then exact inputs and shared-step Defect links are retained
